text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Akebono-san, here is your birthday 
present! They are tickets to the Grand 
Sumo Tournament!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Huh! I-I-Is this from the March grand 
tournament~?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And for opening day, in a Box S seat, 
no less! Let's all three of us go watch it 
together!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
W-Wow, incredible! Box Seat S tickets are 
fantastic seats, and they're so popular 
it's super hard to get them...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Besides... it's just my personal hobby, 
are you really sure you don't mind tagging 
along?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Of coouuurse I do!! The sumo stories 
Akebono-san shares with me always get my 
heart pumping so fast!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A clash of raw power against power! A 
dead-serious slugfest!! As an aspiring 
princess, I am utterly fascinated!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Sumo is a worldwide and dynamic sport! I 
have a great deal of interest in it too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'm happy to have the tickets, but what 
makes me happiest is getting to enjoy it 
with you two!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Heheh! Then in March, the three of us are 
going on a trip to Osaka to watch Grand 
Sumo!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hooray~! I'm so looking forward to it! 
Since we're going anyway, let's go eat 
some flavorful Osaka-style chanko stew, 
too~!
